name: Love Note
source:
There is a special notebook. Humans who have their names written in this notebook become overcome with lust. The Grim Reaper Rukia drops it in the human world for an unknown purpose. Our protagonist then finds it and uses to satisfy all his secret desires.

[Paraphrased from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-july-2005-swan-song.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
世上有一本特殊的笔记本，凡是名字被写在其中的人，都会被难以遏制的情欲支配。死神朽木露琪亚出于某个不为人知的目的，把它丢进了人间。主人公随后捡到这本笔记，并用它满足自己所有隐秘的欲望。

[据[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-july-2005-swan-song.html]vndbreview[/url]内容改写]
